description:
Unofficial desktop app for Facebook Messenger, without the rest of Facebook.

Chatpane wraps the Facebook Messenger web app in a small native window and strips away the rest of Facebook: no Feed, no Reels, no Marketplace. It adds native notifications, an unread badge and privacy options.
Chatpane is an independent open-source project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta Platforms, Inc. Messenger and Facebook are trademarks of Meta.
Keep messages people unsend, go full screen, and find every setting where you'd expect it.
What's New
- Keep unsent messages. Turn on Settings → Account & Privacy → Keep unsent messages, and when someone unsends a message while Chatpane is running, you still see it under Messenger's "unsent a message" notice, marked "Kept by Chatpane". This works in encrypted chats too. Copies are encrypted with a key in your system's password store, never leave your computer, and are deleted after 7 or 30 days, when you turn the setting off, or with Delete All. It's off by default.
- Full screen. Press F11 on Windows and Linux, or use View → Enter Full Screen (⌃⌘F) on macOS.
- Settings, reorganized. Six tabs, each with related settings grouped together: Mute next to Do Not Disturb, Active Status and Read Receipts next to Block Typing Indicator, and the window options next to the tray. Settings stored in your Facebook account are marked Syncs with Facebook.
- custom.css applies when you save it after opening it from Settings → Advanced → Open custom.css, without reloading Chatpane.
Bug Fixes
- Windows: the minimize, maximize and close buttons are now the same size as Windows' own at every display scale. At 150% they were a third smaller.
- Windows: the chat no longer runs into the bottom of the window, and the gap above it is smaller. The same goes for Linux when Chatpane draws its own window controls.
- Linux: the AppImage, .deb and .rpm start on Debian 12, Ubuntu 22.04 and the distros based on them. 3.2.0 needed a newer system library than they have.
- The connection screen shows the app icon you chose in Settings instead of a generic speech bubble.
- winget now lists the Windows on ARM installer as ARM64.
Internal
- Mid-November dependency update, including Tauri 2.12.6.
